limitations: Headless actual LIN. Control/capture phases contain no LIN diagnostic reads. Readback follows the control hold/capture. Firmware Fade capture performs ten built-in LED read samples. Regular firmware diagnostics remain enabled. Optical light output is not measured.
overall_assessment: The full hour passed the specified steady-operation checks excluding A Logo, but follow-up capture including command start found shortened initial pulses on all four chairs and one 0C period maximum of 36 ms at 30 Hz. Do not interpret the hour result as proof that all transition timing is within 2 ms.

followup_findings.scope: A/B/C/D LH, 30 Hz, duty 188/250, initial command transition
followup_findings.finding: Including command-start capture had ON minima 14-23 ms in the 16 captures; configured steady ON is about 25 ms. Steady captures had ON range 24-26 ms.
followup_findings.explanation: The source starts flicker phase at command reception but faded RGB is refreshed in the 10 ms section. This is consistent with delayed first ON; the exact transient waveform was not externally measured.

followup_findings.finding: One 1-second capture had maximum period 36 ms and maximum OFF 11 ms; nominal period 33.333 ms and OFF 8.267 ms, approximately +2.67/+2.73 ms. This exceeds the 2 ms tolerance.
followup_findings.cause: Not established. Aggregate capture does not identify which cycle contained the maximum. Do not ascribe it solely to the first pulse.
followup_findings.other_observation: All 16 captures armed after 250 ms stayed within 2 ms.

final_output_after_followup: OFF sent to all four chairs; verification stopped; LIN client disconnected.
